findings.title: Customer asks whether contract/data-processing terms are changing for renewal
findings.description: Eleanor asks whether anything is changing in the agreement — new terms, data clauses, anything her firm's risk/legal team would scrutinize. Sam confirms nothing material changed and offers to resend the DPA. This is a contract/legal review question tied to the renewal, not a report of a product defect or a request for a new product capability.
findings.quote: is there anything I should be aware of that's changing? New terms, data clauses, anything my risk people will chew on?
findings.severity_reason: Informational contract question with no product impact; no action needed beyond the offered DPA resend.
findings.match_note: Not a product bug or feature request — it's a legal/contract terms inquiry, so no catalogue match applies.

findings.title: Customer asks for reminder of data hosting region for risk team
findings.description: Eleanor asks which region her firm's data is hosted in, saying her risk team always asks and she always forgets. Sam confirms hosting is in-region as at signing and offers to include the specifics in a written note she can forward. No discrepancy, defect, or unmet requirement is described — it's a request to be reminded of existing, unchanged information.
findings.quote: Hosting region — remind me, we're data-resident where? Risk always asks and I always forget.
findings.severity_reason: Purely informational; no defect or gap in the product or its documentation is alleged.
findings.match_note: No specific product problem stated — just a request to recall existing hosting-region info, so nothing to file.

findings.title: Customer requests a 'what's new' summary of recent product changes
findings.description: Eleanor asks if there's anything new in the product, feature-wise, so she can sound informed when associates ask her about it. Sam summarizes generally (mobile experience, reporting polish) and offers to send a short 'what's new since you signed' write-up alongside the pricing. This is a request for an informational summary of already-released changes, not a report of a missing capability or defect.
findings.quote: is there anything new in the product I should be aware of, feature-wise? My associates ask me things and I like to sound informed.
findings.severity_reason: No specific unmet need or defect described; purely a request for a briefing document.
findings.match_note: No concrete feature gap or bug named — customer wants a recap, not a change to the product, so no catalogue match.

findings.title: Customer asks about ongoing availability of BetterBark webinar series
findings.description: Eleanor asks whether the BetterBark webinars are still running after an associate attended one on feedback conversations and enjoyed it. Sam confirms monthly cadence and offers to add the associate to the difficult-conversations follow-up series. This concerns a training/services offering (webinars), not the core software product's functionality.
findings.quote: are you still doing the webinars? One of my associates went to one on "feedback conversations" and came back weirdly evangelical about it.
findings.severity_reason: Relates to a services/training offering, not the product itself; no defect or capability gap.
findings.match_note: Webinar scheduling is a services topic outside the product catalogue's scope, so no match applies.

findings.title: Customer relays positive feedback about coaching from a skeptical associate
findings.description: Eleanor shares that even her most skeptical senior associate, who dismisses programs as 'HR theater,' admitted his BetterBark coach was 'not a waste of time.' This is positive, secondhand-relayed sentiment about the coaching service with no complaint, defect, or requested change attached.
findings.quote: Even the skeptical senior associate — the one who calls everything "HR theater" — admitted his coach was "not a waste of time," which is a rave from him.
findings.severity_reason: Positive feedback with no issue or request; purely anecdotal color for the renewal conversation.
findings.match_note: No defect or feature ask present — favorable anecdote only, so nothing to log against the catalogue.
